description: The SAP S/4HANA Sales connector provides APIs that enable seamless integration with the [Customer Return (A2X) API v1.1.0](https://api.sap.com/api/API_CUSTOMER_RETURN_SRV/overview). The service allows to create, read, update, and delete returns orders for customer returns.
key-features: Create, read, update, and delete customer returns in SAP S/4HANA
Seamless integration with the Customer Return (A2X) API v1.1.0
Support for basic and OAuth 2.0 authentication
Full CRUD operations for return items, partners, pricing elements, and texts
